items.title: Netflix (NFLX) Is Down 8.7% After Wells Fargo Flags Engagement Risks From YouTube And Rivals
items.summary: In recent days, Wells Fargo downgraded Netflix after flagging weaker viewer engagement and rising pressure from rivals such as YouTube, intensifying concerns about how much time subscribers spend on the platform. The downgrade has thrown a spotlight on whether Netflix’s push into formats like live sports, video podcasts, and short-form “Verts” can meaningfully revive engagement. items.title: A Wells Fargo Analyst Noticed He Stopped Watching Netflix, Then Told Clients to Sell
items.summary: A Wells Fargo analyst noticed something personal about his own Netflix habits, turned it into a formal downgrade, and put himself against nearly every other analyst covering the stock. Whether that instinct is genius or noise depends on what happens to Netflix engagement over the next two quarters.

items.title: The Case for Buying Netflix Stock
items.summary: While Netflix’s near-term growth trajectory is facing some pressure, the significant pullback indicates that negatives are already priced in the stock.
